description: This PHP source file defines the Tasks class for managing installation and connection tasks for MySQL and MariaDB databases within the Drupal framework. It includes methods for checking database versions, establishing connections, creating databases if missing, and ensuring InnoDB engine availability.

classes.name: Tasks
classes.description: A class extending Drupal's InstallTasks to handle MySQL/MariaDB installation and connection verification, including version checks and engine support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Tasks object and adds the ensureInnoDbAvailable task.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the database type name, distinguishing between MariaDB and MySQL or equivalent.

methods.name: minimumVersion
methods.description: Returns the minimum required version for MariaDB or MySQL based on the connection.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Attempts to establish a database connection, creating the database if it does not exist, and handles connection errors.

methods.name: getFormOptions
methods.description: Provides configuration options for database connection forms, including port default and transaction isolation level.

methods.name: ensureInnoDbAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the InnoDB storage engine is available in the database.
